title: Retire the terminal advisor; one meaning for 'the advisor'
why: Your worry, Oct 26: the advisor setup is delicate, and your Mac sessions seem to report an advisor review that may not exist.
note: Checked Oct 26 at claude-settings 149f4bc5. Three things were called advisor: (1) Claude Code's built-in advisor (settings.json advisorModel: opus), a second opinion a session calls on its own, seeing only its own conversation; its transcript line ends 'Reviewed', 'Declined' or 'Unavailable', the likely source of the Mac 'advisor review'; (2) the terminal advisor, a Windows-only advisor-xx session from C:\advisor started by start-advisor.ps1; (3) this cloud project, which answers only you. Your ruling, Oct 26: retire the terminal advisor once cloud building (c52) runs. Your ruling, Oct 26 03:40 UTC: retire it now, with the repo route; bring the roadmap page back in house; delete the old artifacts so nothing confuses. Plan: (a) claude-settings PR removes the advisor- route: rule questions-ask-advisor-first becomes 'questions go to the owner'; the report drops 'Decided by the advisor'; sendmessage_state.py and the SendMessage judge drop the advisor- pass; decision advisor-answers-questions is rewritten in place; the built-in advisor stays, named as a second opinion only, never a decision. (b) Record: start-advisor.ps1 removed; CLAUDE.md cut to mechanics; the roadmap page https://claude.ai/artifact/R3iCpK91QRjC5he8bwfY7m refreshed in place from roadmap.html and republished after each build. (c) Old artifact pages and frozen project-file copies deleted after your yes. The advisor repo itself stays (never delete or archive it without your yes). Your ruling, Oct 26 04:02 UTC: the record (roadmap, briefs, plans, handoffs) moves to a roadmap branch of claude-settings, with the advisor repo's history: direct pushes, no PR, no CI (main's protection needs a PR and 10 checks, admins included). The page mirrors it, republished after each build. The advisor repo stays until you say what to do with it. On a local machine: delete C:\advisor's launcher shortcut and ~/.claude-advisor (local, your call). Oct 26: PR #578 (retire the terminal advisor route: rule questions-ask-advisor-first renamed questions-go-to-owner, label 'Decided by the advisor' removed and refused by the report gate, advisor- name pass removed) is a draft in review; stops at green (c53). Not batched with #577, whose CI was already running. Advisor repo 945b6ce: start-advisor.ps1 removed.
ask: No brief: built in this project (thread 'Retire the terminal advisor setup'). Local cleanup on Windows, when you like: delete the Start Advisor shortcut, C:\advisor\start-advisor.ps1 (gone from the repo after a pull) and the folder %USERPROFILE%\.claude-advisor.
